name: OMTech Q3
tagline: Q-switched fiber marker that works on the bench, split or handheld, in 30W and 50W versions
tldr: The Q3, also called the HQ Series by OMTech, is a Q-switched fiber marker listed on OMTech's store at the end of October 2026. It runs in three ways: a desktop column, a split setup where the processing unit leaves the base (about 15 minutes to convert), and a handheld mode where a 3.2 kg quick-release head is pressed against large or fixed parts, keeping the 150 × 150 mm field. OMTech lists 3 mm deep engraving, a 0.06 mm minimum line width, 10,000 mm/s and a 170 mm processing height. Prices: $1,799.99 for the 30W and $2,699.99 for the 50W (OMTech store, October 2026). Focus is manual and the laser is Class 4. Open a version for exact specs and benchmarks.
mainObjective: Metal marking on the bench and on parts too large to bring to the machine

priceRange.note: Official OMTech store, Oct 2026: 30W $1,799.99, 50W $2,699.99 (regular prices $3,599.99 and $4,899.99)

pros: Three work modes in one machine, including a handheld head for parts that do not fit under a column
Larger 150 × 150 mm field than most compact desktop fibers, in every mode
170 mm processing height and 0–30° head tilt for tall or angled parts
cons: Manual focus and no camera: height and placement are set by hand for each part
Class 4 open laser: goggles and a controlled area are required
Q-switched source: no color marking on stainless steel
beginnerNotes: This overview covers the OMTech Q3 line. Take the 30W if a lower price matters more than speed, the 50W if you engrave deep logos or run repeat jobs where time counts. Both have the same modes, field and software; compare them with the chips above.
proTips: Build a simple jig for the desktop mode and keep the handheld head for parts that cannot move: it is the same 150 × 150 mm field, held by hand. Recheck focus every time the part height changes, since there is no autofocus.
primaryUse: Q-switched fiber marker line for metal marking on the bench, split or handheld

editorialDepth.advantages: The Q3 adds what fixed desktop fibers lack: a quick-release head that goes to the part. For shops marking tool cabinets, machine panels, molds or other objects that will not fit under a column, it replaces a separate handheld marker, and the 150 × 150 mm field stays the same in every mode.
editorialDepth.limitations: It is a Class 4 machine with manual focus, so it asks for more care than an enclosed fiber. The Q-switched source marks black, white and depth, not colors, and OMTech forbids wood and paper. The line is brand new, without owner feedback yet.

faq.question: Which OMTech Q3 should I buy?
faq.answer: The 30W ($1,799.99) if a lower upfront cost matters most; the 50W ($2,699.99) if you engrave deep logos or run repeat jobs. In OMTech's own deep-engraving example, the 30W took about 110 minutes and the 50W about 60. Prices on OMTech's store in October 2026.

faq.question: What does 3-in-1 mean on the OMTech Q3?
faq.answer: The same machine works as a desktop marker on its column, as a split setup with the processing unit moved off the base (about 15 minutes to convert), or as a handheld marker with the 3.2 kg quick-release head pressed flat against the part. The marking field stays 150 × 150 mm in every mode.
